Guideline: Use packages/yolo-tauri for Tauri 3.0 Alpha + Wry 0.57 + Tao 0.37
Description: yolo-tauri unifies Tauri v3.0.0-alpha.5, Wry 0.57.1, Tao 0.37.2, Muda 0.21.2, Tray-Icon 0.26.1, Window-Vibrancy 0.8.1 and Global-Hotkey 0.9.0
Do: Import window, vibrancy, tray and capability helpers from yolo-tauri
Don't: Mix Tauri v1 allowlist configs with Tauri v2/v3 ACL capabilities

Guideline: Enforce Principle of Least Privilege with ACL capabilities
Description: Tauri v3 uses granular capability JSON/TOML files in capabilities/ scoped to specific windows and commands
Do: Grant only the required plugin permissions per window label in capabilities/default.json
Don't: Enable wildcard core:default + shell:allow-execute for untrusted remote URLs

Guideline: Apply native window vibrancy per YoloThemePreset
Description: submodules/window-vibrancy supports Windows 11 Mica/Acrylic, macOS Liquid Glass/HudWindow, and transparent Wayland surfaces
Do: Configure transparent: true on WebviewWindowBuilder and apply the preset vibrancy (Mica for Fluent, NSVisualEffectMaterial for Apple)
Don't: Use heavy CSS backdrop-filter blurs on an opaque native window without OS compositor integration
Code Bad: // opaque window with fake CSS blur only

Guideline: Use typed #[tauri::command] and Channel<T> for streaming
Description: Tauri v3 IPC supports fast binary payloads (tauri::ipc::Response) and streaming events via tauri::ipc::Channel<T>
Do: Stream progress, LLM tokens or large buffers over Channel<T> or raw ipc::Response
Don't: Serialize multi-megabyte byte arrays as JSON number arrays over invoke
Code Good: #[tauri::command] async fn stream_data(ch: tauri::ipc::Channel<Chunk>) -> Result<(), String>
Code Bad: #[tauri::command] fn read_blob() -> Vec<u8> // JSON-serialized array of numbers

Description: Yolo UI includes both Wry 0.57 (system WebView2 / WebKitGTK / WKWebView) and CEF (tauri-runtime-cef) for pixel-identical Chromium features
Do: Default to Wry for tiny binaries (~3MB) and opt into CEF only when WebGPU/WebRTC parity across Linux distros requires Chromium
Don't: Ship a 150MB CEF bundle for a simple settings utility
Code Bad: // bundling CEF unnecessarily when system WebView suffices

Guideline: Build native menus and tray icons with muda and tray-icon
Description: submodules/muda and submodules/tray-icon provide cross-platform native menubars, context menus and system tray integration
Do: Use tauri::menu::MenuBuilder and tauri::tray::TrayIconBuilder with dark/light icon variants
Don't: Render fake HTML menubars on macOS where users expect the system menu bar
Code Bad: // custom DOM menu bar that ignores macOS global menu

Guideline: Synchronize OS color scheme and YoloThemePreset
Description: Listen to WindowEvent::ThemeChanged and inject the matching YoloThemePreset CSS variables into the WebView
Do: Read window.theme() at startup and emit theme updates to both native chrome and WebView DOM
Don't: Let the native titlebar stay light while the WebView renders a dark theme
Code Bad: // mismatched light Win32 titlebar on dark app

Guideline: Share plugins-workspace v3 for iOS and Android
Description: submodules/cargo-mobile2 and submodules/plugins-workspace support mobile targets with safe-area insets and native haptics
Do: Respect env(safe-area-inset-*) in CSS and use tauri-plugin-haptics / dialog / notification on mobile
Don't: Assume desktop window resize or global-hotkey APIs exist on iOS/Android

Guideline: Instrument Tauri apps with CrabNebula DevTools
Description: submodules/tauri-devtools (crabnebula-devtools) inspects IPC calls, events, logs, and span timings in real time
Do: Register tauri_plugin_devtools::init() in debug builds and launch via bun ui devtools tauri
Don't: Ship devtools instrumentation in production release builds

Guideline: Manage shared backend state with app.manage(Mutex<T>)
Description: Tauri commands run concurrently; shared Rust state must be registered with Manager::manage and locked briefly
Do: Use tauri::State<'_, Mutex<AppState>> and drop the lock before awaiting async I/O
Don't: Hold a std::sync::MutexGuard across an .await point or use global mutable statics
Code Good: #[tauri::command] async fn save(state: tauri::State<'_, tokio::sync::Mutex<Db>>) -> Result<(), String>
